# Edviro

> Edviro is autonomous building energy management. It connects your meters, controls, and utility data, watches every building 24/7, catches energy waste as it starts, fixes it, and proves the savings with audit-grade measurement and verification (M&V). Backed by Y Combinator.

## What Edviro does

Edviro closes the loop on building energy where most tools stop at a dashboard:

- Ingest: connect bills, meters, weather, tariffs, BMS, work orders, and sensors into one live model. Nothing to rip out.
- Detect: learn each building's normal load, schedules, and equipment, then flag drift, anomalies, and waste in real time.
- Act: raise work orders, guide facilities teams in the app, and adjust setpoints and schedules, after testing each change first.
- Verify: confirm every change in the meter data and on the utility bill with audit-grade M&V.

## Who it is for

- School facilities and K-12 districts: continuous energy audits, automatic fault detection, and work orders for the team that runs the building.
- Commercial real estate and offices: occupancy-aware HVAC and lighting using existing WiFi routers, cutting energy and peak demand charges while keeping tenants comfortable.
- Construction teams: independent baselining and audit-grade M&V built into the build, so savings claims hold up for owners and lenders.

- Over $400K saved for clients to date.
- 7 school sites live, with 29 more expanding.
- 24/7 autonomous monitoring across every site.
